from itertools import permutations

# Conventional semantic classes of adjectives. Single-adjective examples
# impose no ordering constraints.
classes = {
    "opinion": "lovely silly good wonderful awful terrible ridiculous mysterious "
               "repulsive nice",
    "size": "huge medium-size large normal-size tiny massive midsize enormous small",
    "age": "ancient archaic new old-fashioned old brand-new",
    "shape": "spherical prismlike rectangular circular square triangular pyramidal",
    "color": "maroon blue pink cyan black magenta white brown gray teal crimson "
             "violet green yellow indigo",
    "origin": "russian thai vietnamese bangladeshi brazilian mexican egyptian "
              "chinese american pakistani japanese iranian nigerian filipino "
              "indian turkish german ethiopian",
    "material": "paper fiberglass glass wool cloth leather wood rubber iron "
                "cardboard plastic steel",
    "purpose": "hiking driving walking drinking exercise smoking typing eating "
               "snorkeling whittling",
}
category = {
    word: name
    for name, words in classes.items()
    for word in words.split()
}

# All examples containing multiple adjectives, with their example numbers.
evidence = {
    4: "paper ancient",
    11: "bangladeshi spherical",
    16: "glass archaic",
    17: "maroon good",
    18: "mexican prismlike",
    19: "medium-size hiking",
    20: "egyptian prismlike",
    27: "vietnamese prismlike",
    30: "wool ancient",
    32: "american spherical",
    33: "brazilian triangular",
    35: "glass ancient",
    36: "mexican spherical",
    40: "triangular large new",
    41: "pakistani rectangular",
    44: "russian circular",
    47: "leather ancient",
    49: "blue wonderful",
    50: "thai pyramidal",
    51: "wood archaic",
    58: "normal-size walking",
    59: "nigerian square",
    60: "iranian triangular",
    70: "black silly",
    71: "magenta terrible",
    72: "chinese rectangular",
    83: "glass brand-new",
    87: "white mysterious",
    89: "leather archaic",
    93: "glass old",
    98: "iranian triangular",
    101: "white repulsive",
    108: "blue awful",
    110: "vietnamese square",
    114: "filipino spherical",
    120: "indian pyramidal",
    124: "leather old-fashioned",
    125: "midsize driving",
    126: "leather archaic",
    127: "paper archaic",
    128: "american triangular",
    133: "gray silly",
    140: "large typing",
    144: "wood ancient",
    147: "german prismlike",
    150: "crimson lovely",
    151: "cloth archaic",
    153: "ethiopian pyramidal",
    155: "violet good",
    157: "cloth old",
    163: "crimson nice",
    164: "crimson lovely",
    168: "german rectangular",
    171: "black repulsive",
    175: "iranian eating glass",
    176: "american spherical",
    182: "turkish triangular",
    184: "tiny snorkeling",
    186: "turkish rectangular",
    191: "violet nice",
    196: "cloth old",
    197: "paper old",
    199: "medium-size snorkeling",
    200: "tiny typing",
}

options = {
    "A": "massive hiking wool old-fashioned green silly",
    "B": "repulsive midsize typing plastic brand-new pyramidal ethiopian",
    "C": "ethiopian rectangular medium-size driving glass ancient repulsive",
    "D": "turkish circular massive whittling cardboard old yellow lovely",
    "E": "japanese prismlike small eating paper old-fashioned indigo",
    "F": "massive typing paper old-fashioned ridiculous gray",
    "G": "pyramidal medium-size drinking steel new pink ridiculous",
    "H": "violet lovely enormous hiking leather new triangular",
    "I": "terrible brown normal-size typing glass old triangular japanese",
    "J": "bangladeshi prismlike huge drinking wood ancient",
}

def sequence(text):
    return tuple(category[word] for word in text.split())

constraints = set()
for text in evidence.values():
    seq = sequence(text)
    constraints.update(
        (seq[i], seq[j])
        for i in range(len(seq))
        for j in range(i + 1, len(seq))
    )

# Exhaust every possible global ordering of the eight adjective classes.
models = []
for order in permutations(classes):
    rank = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(order)}
    if all(rank[a] < rank[b] for a, b in constraints):
        models.append(rank)

if not models:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: the examples admit no global category order.")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
else:
    possible = []
    guaranteed = []
    for label, text in options.items():
        seq = sequence(text)
        count = sum(
            all(rank[a] < rank[b] for a, b in zip(seq, seq[1:]))
            for rank in models
        )
        print("{}: valid in {}/{} compatible category orders".format(
            label, count, len(models)
        ))
        if count:
            possible.append(label)
        if count == len(models):
            guaranteed.append(label)

    print("Exhaustive models:", len(models))
    print("Choices compatible with the examples:", "".join(possible) or "K")
    print("Choices valid in every compatible order:",
          "".join(guaranteed) or "(none)")
    print("Note: the examples do not uniquely fix the entire category order.")

    submitted = "K"
    if guaranteed:
        # Even without choosing among the underdetermined category orders,
        # a guaranteed valid option decisively disproves 'none of the above'.
        print("Counterexample to K:", guaranteed[0])
        print("Submitted:", submitted)
        print("CHECK FAIL")
    elif not possible:
        print("Submitted:", submitted)
        print("CHECK PASS")
    else:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: no option is guaranteed across all category orders.")
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
